words.selling: Selling volume = the dollar volume (close × shares traded) of the members that closed lower that day.
words.buying: Buying volume = the dollar volume of the members that closed higher that day.
words.normal: Normal = the group's own usual daily dollar volume of the recent past.
words.heavy: Heavy volume = a stock trading far above its own normal volume.
words.share: Selling share = the % of the day's dollar volume that traded in falling stocks.
words.accumulation: Accumulation = the % of the group's stocks that rose on heavy volume.
